question: What efficacy belongs to the tithi-syllabled mantra of the axe?
premises: The mantra is described as tithi-syllabled.
It is associated with the axe.
It is said to grant success in battle.
inference: This tithi-syllabled axe mantra confers success in battle.
uncertainties: The exact syllabic count implied by tithyakṣara is not specified here.
plain_english: This tithi-syllabled mantra of the axe grants success in battle.
